Some destinies are prisons. Some families are curses. And some witches refuse to be tamed.

Sage Brighton was born to serve. As a Queen witch, her life – and her magic – belong to an immortal Lady who demands absolute loyalty. Along the mist-shrouded cliffs of the Pacific Northwest, Sage and her twin sister Wren are trained to be the Lady's most powerful Hands. But behind the family's shining legacy, secrets fester and rebellion stirs.

When Wren's recklessness threatens to expose them, Sage must choose: cling to the crumbling world she was raised to protect – or risk everything to forge her own future.

In a house built on loyalty and lies, survival may cost Sage her soul.

Perfect for readers who love atmospheric magic, fierce heroines, dark family secrets, and slow-burn rebellion.

Queen Witch is the first novel in the Foulweather Twins trilogy. After Queen Witch, read Chaos Calling and The Unseen Mirror.
